summary: Carey voted Yea on the Antisemitism Awareness Act, which embeds the IHRA definition in federal education-discrimination enforcement. He cosponsored a House resolution condemning antisemitism and honoring two Israeli embassy employees murdered in Washington, and in October 2025 supported ending the Gaza war while framing it as a response to the October 7 Hamas attack and praising the President's ceasefire leadership. Vote for Peace rated him Opposed in the general election.
